say:2:1033428002:1.text: Day and night, I heard troops marching as I lay in bed.
say:2:1033428002:1.source_cn: 这几个月无论是白天和夜晚，躺在床上的我都能听到列队行进...
say:2:1033428002:1.male: Day and night, I heard troops marching as I lay in bed.
say:2:1033428002:1.female: Day and night, I heard troops marching as I lay in bed.

say:3:1033428003:1.text: I was too fragile to do anything; I couldn't even pull myself out of bed.
say:3:1033428003:1.source_cn: 可当时的我只能躺在病床上，连下床开门的力气都没有。
say:3:1033428003:1.male: I was too fragile to do anything; I couldn't even pull myself out of bed.
say:3:1033428003:1.female: I was too fragile to do anything; I couldn't even pull myself out of bed.

say:4:1033428004:1.text: I finally regained some strength from the vegetable soup I had these days. However, as I managed to open my door, I saw the Thorned Guards passing in a hurry.
say:4:1033428004:1.source_cn: 这几天吃了些蔬菜汤，终于有了点力气，结果推开门一看，都...
say:4:1033428004:1.male: I finally regained some strength from the vegetable soup I had these days. However, as I managed to open my door, I saw the Thorned Guards passing in a hurry.
say:4:1033428004:1.female: I finally regained some strength from the vegetable soup I had these days. However, as I managed to open my door, I saw the Thorned Guards passing in a hurry.
